svg.text: THE DRIVING TEST · 8 CASES × 3 ATTEMPTS · THREE REAL SUITE RUNS
THE LINE UNDER TEST (ANALYST_PROMPT, since Part 6):
"Every number you state must come from a query result or script output. Never do arithmetic in your head."
Same suite, same data, same judge. The only change between the columns is one sentence in the system prompt.
Every failure in run 2 is arithmetic the model did in its head: a share, a growth rate, a six-number total.
Part 10 called prompt engineering probabilistic, not mechanical:
write the rule, measure the rate, keep the receipts. This is the measuring.
